title: Rule Book leaves an exact season tiebreak without an outcome
steps: Use a normal season where Daniel and Nik earn the same Showdown score, for example 0 to 0.
Give both managers the same league finishing position, for example 2nd.
Give both managers the same league points, for example 80.
expected: The Rule Book should give a terminal result for this valid tie state, with DRAW as the sensible fallback when position and league points are also equal.
actual: Section 05 says better league position wins, then more league points wins, while also excluding goal difference, goals scored and head to head. It gives no result when both fallback values are equal.
root_cause: The tiebreak list stops after league points and has no final exact-tie clause.
checked_against: index.html season result inputs and scoring text

fix.change: Add a final rule stating that if Showdown points, league position and league points are all equal, the season result is DRAW. Keep the implementation's season result label aligned with that rule.

assumptions: Daniel and Nik play separate Career Mode saves, so the same finishing position and same league points can occur in normal play.
When every allowed tiebreak value is equal, DRAW is the sensible terminal result rather than inventing another criterion.
